title: Thai Red Curry with Chicken & Cashews
headnote: DRAFT / UNTESTED OUTCOME. Reconstructed from July 19, 2025 personal recipe discussion: the user's chosen build uses an entire 4 oz Maesri red curry paste can, two cans coconut milk, rotisserie chicken, a sautéed large onion, and roasted cashews. No confirmed personal tasting verdict was recovered.

ingredientGroups.title: Curry
items: 113 g Maesri red curry paste (one 4 oz can)
2 cans full-fat coconut milk (approximately 800 g total; confirm your can sizes)
Cooked rotisserie chicken, cut into bite-size pieces (quantity to taste; not specified in original discussion)
85–115 g roasted unsalted cashews (original suggestion: ¾–1 cup; approximate)
A little neutral oil to sauté onion
Fresh lime juice to finish, optional

steps: Sauté the thinly sliced onion in a little neutral oil over medium heat until softened and lightly golden.
Add the entire can of Maesri red curry paste and fry briefly until fragrant.
Stir in the two cans of coconut milk, loosening the paste into the sauce. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the cooked rotisserie chicken, fish sauce, and sugar. Gently simmer until the chicken is heated through and the flavors meld.
Stir in the roasted cashews near the end so they retain some crunch. Taste, adjust fish sauce or sugar if needed, and add a squeeze of lime if desired.
